'''Grand Admiral Tsung Dark Squadron''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Grand Admiral Tsung]]
* '''Published:''' 15 February 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' —
* '''Strategy:''' Dark Squadron
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 Dark Squadron Tsung DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Capitol Starships, A couple a good pilots and a ton of fighters...  The Empire's tried and true path to domination.

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

Start out using Prepared defenses.
Battle and Overwhelm
Force Drain
Kill some more
Choke with Vader
Get Executor out as fast as possible


Anybody know of an objective that would work well with this deck?
